title.en: Need mixing and pumping on site. Is that a mixing plant?
title.zh: 现场要搅拌并泵送，那是搅拌站吗？

description.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists an electric integrated mixer pump and a diesel mixer. The category text says they are not a concrete mixing plant line.
description.zh: 不是。河北品锦机械列出电动搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵。分类说明写明它们不是混凝土搅拌站产品线。

h1.en: Need mixing and pumping on site. Is that a mixing plant?
h1.zh: 现场要搅拌并泵送，那是搅拌站吗？

directAnswer.en: No. Open the mixer-pump pages. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints two machines that mix and pump in one unit. The electric one is 45 kW plus 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 100 m / 300 m and aggregate 4 cm and below, for sites with grid power, including the published rural and self-built sentence. The diesel one is 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, with separate fine-stone, 13 mm and 24 mm distances. The selection guide says these are not mixing plants.
directAnswer.zh: 不是。打开搅拌泵页面。邢台河北品锦机械印了两台搅拌与泵送一体的机器。电机型是 45 kW 加 14 kW、21 m³/h、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下，用于有电网的工地，包括已公布的农村与自建房那一句。柴油型是 66–75 kW、25 m³/h，并分开细石、13 mm 和 24 mm 距离。选型指南写明它们不是搅拌站。

heading.en: A trailer pump does not mix

body.en: Electric and diesel trailer pumps place concrete that is already in the hopper. If the site only needs placement, stay on those hubs. If the site must mix and pump because there is no separate mixer, the two integrated machines are the published answer. There is no third “plant” model.
body.zh: 电动和柴油拖泵浇筑的是已经在料斗里的混凝土。现场只需要浇筑时，留在那些分类页。现场因为没有单独搅拌机而必须搅拌并泵送时，已公布的答案就是这两台一体机。没有第三台“搅拌站”型号。

heading.en: Weight and power are site limits
heading.zh: 重量和动力是现场限制

body.en: The electric mixer is 4500 kg. The diesel mixer is 4200 kg. They are not the 450 kg Electric 15. A self-built sentence on the mixer page does not shrink the frame. Confirm access and power before treating the rural sentence as a compact pump.
body.zh: 电动搅拌泵是 4500 kg。柴油搅拌泵是 4200 kg。它们不是 450 kg 的电动15。搅拌泵页面上的自建房句子不会把机架变小。在把农村那句话当成紧凑泵之前，先确认进场和动力。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say whether concrete arrives ready, or must be mixed on the machine. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明混凝土是到达即可浇，还是必须在机器上搅拌。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: The site does not publish a mixing-plant product. /products/mixer-pumps is the related page, and it says these machines are not that line.
answer.zh: 网站没有公布搅拌站产品。相关页面是 /products/mixer-pumps，并且写明这些机器不是那条产品线。

answer.en: The figure matches Electric 40’s output cell, but Electric 40 does not include a 14 kW mixer motor and does not print the mix-and-pump scenario.
answer.zh: 数字和电动40的输送量格相同，但电动40没有 14 kW 搅拌电机，也没有印搅拌加泵送的工况。

alt.en: Integrated mixer pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery, a mix-and-pump machine rather than a mixing plant
alt.zh: 河北品锦机械搅拌泵一体机，是搅拌并泵送的机器，不是搅拌站
